places.name: Lily's Bedroom
places.design: A small child's bedroom in a modest, 1970s house. Walls are textured plaster painted a faded creamy-yellow. The floor is dark-stained timber boards. Key objects are: a low, white-painted pine bed against the wall opposite the door; a matching bedside table with a ceramic star-shaped night-light; and a white-painted wooden wardrobe in the corner by the window. The only permanent light is the small star lamp, emitting a soft, cold white-blue glow. An early-morning fog condenses on the single-pane window, admitting a dull, grey, pre-dawn light. The room is otherwise in deep shadow.

places.name: Mara's Bedroom
places.design: A master bedroom in the same house. The wallpaper is a dated, small floral pattern in faded teal-greys. Flooring is worn beige carpet. Dominant features are: a dark wooden double bed; a matching dark wood bedside table holding the baby monitor receiver; and a heavy, floor-length dark curtain covering the window. The sole light source is the monitor's digital clock (soft green) and its pulsing red LED indicators. It is deep night; no external light enters.
